description.value: Sproat Lake Park's lower campground sits directly on the warm lakeshore with its own swimming area, 13 km northwest of Port Alberni via paved Highway 4; a short trail also leads to K'ak'awin, considered one of BC's finest prehistoric petroglyph panels.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies 'lower campground' as a camp_site within Sproat Lake Park, a BC provincial park on central Vancouver Island. The website confirms two separate campgrounds exist (upper and lower), with the lower campground offering beach/swimming access and connected to the upper campground by a trail through a highway underpass. OSM tags confirm tents=yes and caravans=yes. The website prominently features a 'Book camping' button and links to frontcountry camping reservation info, confirming reservations are accepted. No specific amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) are mentioned in the fetched website content for this park.
